definitions.explanation: The portion of a Japanese phone number that identifies the local exchange. Most often heard in {市外|しがい}{局番|きょくばん} (area code) and {市内|しない}{局番|きょくばん}.

examples.japanese: {局番|きょくばん}を{間違|まちが}えた。
examples.english: I got the exchange number wrong.

examples.japanese: {市外|しがい}{局番|きょくばん}から{入力|にゅうりょく}してください。
examples.english: Please enter the number starting from the area code.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}の{市外|しがい}{局番|きょくばん}は03だ。

notes:
The middle block of a Japanese landline number, identifying the telephone exchange. Rarely used alone; it usually appears in a fixed compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市外|しがい}{局番|きょくばん}: area code (dialed from outside the local area)
- {市内|しない}{局番|きょくばん}: local exchange number
- {局番|きょくばん}なし: without an exchange number (as with short service numbers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {番号|ばんごう}: number — any number, not specifically the exchange portion
- {内線|ないせん}: extension — an internal line number within an office
